verdict.rationale: Factory publishes an llms.txt file (confirmed HTTP 200 at docs.factory.ai/llms.txt) explicitly describing itself as documentation for an 'agent-native software development platform,' directly enabling an agent to be pointed at it for machine-readable docs; the broader docs site is also structured with agent-oriented features (readiness reports, MCP tools, CLI) that reinforce agent-native consumption. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report of an agent actually consuming llms.txt successfully, and no evidence of additional agent-oriented doc formats (e.g., structured API schemas, since openapi.json probes 404).
